title: Two Countries One Heart — Mbira Folk (Zimbabwe)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm migration heritage storytelling Shona
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The red dust road runs out at the airport gate
Harare behind her, Perth ahead, the weight
Of everything a family built in forty years
Packed into the hold and the eyes that hold the tears

[Verse 2]
Australia came up slow from the plane window
A different kind of red, a different kind of glow
But Kerri held the farm inside her chest
The mbira rhythm steady in the rest

[Chorus]
Two countries one heart
Zimbabwe in the morning, Australia at the start
Of every new beginning they brought both along
Two countries, one heart, one family, one song

[Bridge]
Jeff said — you take the farm with you
It's not in the soil, it's in how you move
Through a day, through a task, through a silence
Jill said — you'll know a Zimbabwe morning anywhere
By how you rise before the town is awake
And get on with it anyway

[Verse 3]
Ari was born between the red earth and the sea
Both countries singing in her naturally
She doesn't know the farm by name yet
But she knows how to begin before the world begins
That's Zimbabwe, that's Jeff, that's Jill — she carries them

[Outro]
Two countries
One heart
The mbira plays on
Two countries one heart
